purpose: Reference points for plausible fictional AeroFlow demo fares, not a live fare feed.
limitations: Displayed from-prices vary by date, availability, fare rules and optional services; these are not guaranteed bookable quotes.
AeroFlow Air, Lotus Sky and Blue Arc remain fictional demo airlines. Generated flight numbers, schedules and fares are not copied live airline inventory.
The existing SQL model uses a 10% demonstration tax rate. It does not reproduce real airline VAT, airport charges or the composition of a real all-in ticket price.
Generated adult totals exclude optional seat selection and additional services. Child and infant demo factors are applied separately by the booking rules.
